notes: First registered model. Synthetic eval validates that the heuristic's (rgb_score, thermal_delta_c) -> class_name mapping is sensible: 32/32 fire recall, 14/15 smoke recall, 43/53 negative recall. Higher false-positive rate (10/53) on synthetic negatives reflects the heuristic's deliberately-loose smoke-grey thresholds; real D-Fire eval is the next gate.
